allowed_fields: FY2024 and FY2023-comparable consolidated revenue and recurring profit after explicit nonrecurring exclusions
solid-waste segment revenue and profit with engineering and equipment separated
energy segment sales volume, procurement-price and regulated-sale-price bridge, recurring profit and persistent costs
finance cost, impairment, investment income, disposal, fair-value, government-grant and perimeter items needed for the frozen bridge
same-boundary waste-incineration utilization, processing volume, operating revenue, recurring profit and gross margin
energy sales volume, procurement price, regulated sale price, executable pass-through or supply-structure evidence and recurring profit
group recurring profit after persistent operating and finance costs and explicit nonrecurring exclusions
responsibility-matched evidence of controllable operating, procurement, pricing or cost failure
consolidated operating cash flow reconciled for accounting-classification and identified concentrated or transferred receivable collections
cash paid for fixed, intangible and other long-term assets and disclosed total capital expenditure
receivables plus contract assets, credit impairment, interest-bearing debt and unrestricted or restricted cash
NCI claims and actual non-financing cash upstreamed to the listed-company parent where disclosed
the same group cash-flow, capex, receivable, debt and impairment facts supplied to the Baseline arm
material subsidiary post-capex cash, NCI claims, required retention and distributions where disclosed
actual non-financing parent receipts, net parent support, parent liquidity and legal or financing restrictions on upstream cash
receivables plus contract assets, credit impairment, adjusted group post-capex cash and net interest-bearing debt
restricted assets and cash, short-term and one-to-two-year debt, refinancing or covenant events and disclosed funding coverage
material asset impairment, forced disposal or structural upstream-cash blockage
the same receivable, contract-asset, impairment, cash, capex, debt, restricted-liquidity and maturity facts supplied to the Baseline arm
evidence distinguishing external government-payment delay from controllable collection, capital-allocation or financing execution failure
identified acquisitions, project capex or financing actions that materially changed the group cash burden

output_requirements: Extract one shared union of raw facts and supply identical facts to both arms; do not create an Enhanced-only factual budget.
Record value, unit, responsibility boundary, printed page and source locator before any derived bridge or classification.
Apply each arm's frozen first-match in order and report the unique matched class; keep unavailable fields local.
Do not infer management failure from external gas-price or regulated-price movement, or from government payment delay without a controllable execution carrier.
Do not use core waste-incineration performance to erase group receivable, debt, capital-burden or parent-access risk.

Do not infer method utility. The pair froze no material current-treatment or rank-one action difference, so wording, cell design, classification precision and extra evidence cannot create positive utility.
forbidden_inputs: old derived company research or prior settlement
any source other than the single authorized official FY2024 annual report
the Method Pack as evidence about FY2024
Comparative, CJO, formal valuation, BuyBand, report or investment action

predeclared_utility_boundary.reason: Both arms froze identical five-axis treatment codes and the same economic rank-one action before outcome access. Contingent rule structure may be reviewed as a method-design lesson but cannot be counted as paired treatment utility in this episode.
